name: agreement drafts
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT type)=3 FROM agreement WHERE type IN ('USER_AGREEMENT','PRIVACY_POLICY','MEDICAL_INFORMED_CONSENT') AND is_deleted=0

name: decoration permissions
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT perm)=7 FROM sys_menu WHERE perm IN ('biz:decoration:cards:list','biz:decoration:cards:update','biz:decoration:promo-cards:list','biz:decoration:promo-cards:update','content:agreement:list','content:agreement:update','content:agreement:publish')

name: appointment capacity
sql: SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM appointment_config WHERE id=1 AND slot_capacity>=1 AND is_deleted=0

name: points rule
sql: SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM marketing_points_rule WHERE id=1 AND is_deleted=0

name: settlement configuration
sql: SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM distribution_settlement_config WHERE id=1 AND is_deleted=0

name: appointment query and configuration permissions
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT perm)=2 FROM sys_menu WHERE perm IN ('biz:appointment:query','biz:appointment:config')

name: appointment permission grants
sql: SELECT COUNT(*)=0 FROM sys_role r CROSS JOIN sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id=r.id AND rm.menu_id=m.id WHERE r.id IN (1,2) AND m.perm IN ('biz:appointment:query','biz:appointment:config') AND rm.menu_id IS NULL

name: active appointment order uniqueness
sql: SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME='appointment' AND INDEX_NAME='uk_appointment_active_order' AND COLUMN_NAME='active_order_id' AND NON_UNIQUE=0

name: active appointment slot uniqueness
sql: SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME='appointment' AND INDEX_NAME='uk_appointment_booked_member_slot' AND COLUMN_NAME='booked_member_slot_key' AND NON_UNIQUE=0
